anomalies.observed: The GND1 and GND2 pins of both isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 are connected to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: GND1 should connect to the logic-side ground and GND2 to an isolated bus-side ground, maintaining galvanic isolation between the logic and CAN bus sides.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9) through an isolated CAN transceiver (U11/companion)

anomalies.impact: The galvanic isolation of the CAN buses is completely defeated, allowing ground loops and common-mode voltages to pass between the logic side and the CAN bus, which can cause communication errors or damage.

anomalies.observed: R8 has a value field of 5.1M, but its MPN (0603WAF5101T5E) and description indicate a 5.1kΩ resistor.
anomalies.expected: R8 should be 5.1kΩ to serve as the required pull-down on USB-C CC2 for a sink device.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R8") (value "5.1M") ... (field (name "MPN") "0603WAF5101T5E") ... (field (name "Description") " 100mW Thick Film Resistors 75V ±100ppm/℃ ±1% 5.1kΩ 0603 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS"))

anomalies.impact: If the value field is used for assembly, the USB-C CC2 pull-down will be 5.1MΩ instead of 5.1kΩ, preventing the USB-C source from detecting the sink in one cable orientation and causing USB power to fail.

anomalies.observed: R36 has a value field of 24k, but its MPN (FRC0805J240TSD) and description indicate a 24Ω resistor.
anomalies.expected: R36 should be 24kΩ (or a value consistent with its role as a bleed/divider resistor across the PoE extraction output).

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R36") (value "24k") ... (field (name "MPN") "FRC0805J240TSD") ... (field (name "Description") " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS"))

anomalies.impact: If the MPN is used for assembly, a 24Ω resistor will be fitted across the PoE output, causing excessive current draw and potential damage to the resistor or the power source.

parsed.summary: The design files contain multiple anomalies: the isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 have their logic and bus grounds tied together, defeating isolation; R8 has a 5.1M value instead of the required 5.1k for USB-C CC2; and R36 has a 24k value while its MPN specifies 24Ω.
